text.what: The flavour bridge: older pinot noir picks up a forest-floor smell, and a plate of fungi meets it head on. Glutamates in the mushroom read as savoury, which is the same register a mature bottle moves into.

kin.as: Its usual companion on the plate.
The wine whose aged character it mirrors.
The expensive end of the same idea.
